circuit.name: Ukulingisa isekethi
circuit.honesty: Isixazululi sethu, sihlolwe ngokuhambisana nezibalo ezivaliwe. Wena ubhala yonke inani lengxenye; amamodeli engxenye omkhiqizi awafundwa noma awafakwa, namafayela e-Multisim awakwazi ukuvulwa.
circuit.cmd.help: Vula iwindi Lokulingisa Isekethi: dweba isikimu bese uyilingisa.
ed.name: Igama lenethi
ed.hint.select: Chofoza iphinikhi, bese uchofoza enye iphinikhi ukuze udwebe intambo. Hudula ingxenye ukuze uyihambise. R iyijikisa, Delete iyisusa.
ed.hint.place: Chofoza ukudweba ukuze ufake {part}. Esc iyama.
ed.hint.name: Chofoza iphinikhi ukuze unikeze inethi yayo igama. Inethi enegama elithi 0 noma gnd ingumhlabathi.
ed.hint.wire: Chofoza iphinikhi ukuze uphelise intambo, indawo engenalutho ukuze wenze uxhumano, noma intambo ukuze uyijoyine. Chofoza kabili noma Esc iyama.
ed.name.label: Igama lenethi, iphinikhi: {pin}
ed.nosel: Khetha ingxenye ukuze ushintshe inani layo.
chk.noground: Isekethi alinawo umhlabathi. Faka uphawu lomhlabathi noma uqambe inethi ngo-0 noma gnd.
chk.twonames: Amanethi {names} ahlanganiswe ngocingo: enye yawo iyisifushane noma igama elingalungile.
chk.dcpath: Inethi {node} ayinendlela ye-DC eya emhlabathini, ngakho umfutho wayo awunqunywa yisekethi. Engeza irezistri eya emhlabathini noma indlela yokuthenga.
chk.sourceloop: {tag} uvala ilophu yemithombo yomfutho namaindukthoro; amanje kulo mlophu awachazwanga. Faka irezistri encane kulo mlophu.
netlist.badvalue: {tag}: {field}: "{text}" akuyona inombolo. Sebenzisa 4.7k, 100n, 1meg (m ingu-milli, meg ingu-mega).
run.empty: Idrowing ayinalutho. Faka ezinye izingxenye, noma layisha isibonelo.
run.badtime: Isikhathi sokuma nesinyathelo kumele kube yizinombolo ezingaphezu kwezeru.
run.toomanysteps: Lokho kungaphezu kwezinyathelo ezingu-{max}. Sebenzisa isinyathelo esikhulu noma isikhathi sokuma esifushane.
run.badfreq: Ukuskena kudinga ukuqala okungaphezu kwezeru nokuphela okungaphezu kokuqala.
run.toomanypoints: Lokho kungaphezu kwamafrikhwensi angu-{max}. Sebenzisa amaphoyinti ambalwa ngeshumi noma uhla oluncane.
run.noacsource: Akukho mthombo onosayizi we-AC. Setha "Usayizi we-AC wokuskena" kumthombo we-DC noma wephalusi, noma sebenzisa umthombo we-AC.
run.noscope: Faka iskophu enethini ukuze ubone umfutho wayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
run.noplot: Faka isiphloti enethini ukuze ubone impendulo yayo ngefrikhwensi.
res.currentnote: Amanje adlula engxenyeni kusuka ephinikhini lokuqala aye kolwesibili (umthombo: kusuka ku+ kuya ku-, ngakho ibhethri elinikeza amanje livela linegatshana).
file.newask: Qala isekethi entsha, engenalutho? Leyo esethuneni iyashintshwa.
file.dropped: Kuvuliwe, kodwa izinto ezingekho emthethweni efayeleni zishiywe: {n}.
file.notcircuit: Leli fayela alisiyona ifayela Lokulingisa Isekethi.
file.version: Leli fayela linguhlobo {v}; le-add-on ifunda uhlobo 1.
file.wire: Intambo efayeleni ayixhumanisi amaphinikhi amabili futhi yashiywa.
file.label: Igama lenethi efayeleni alikho ephinikhini futhi lashiywa.
